mapper.select: SELECT c.cust_nm, rcd.paid_in_rounds, rcd.payment_amount, rcd.penalty_fee, rcd.monthly_payment_date, rcd.payment_status, rcd.unpaid_status FROM rental_contract_details rcd inner join payment p on rcd.rental_contract_no = p.rental_contract_no inner join customer c on rcd.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE rcd.unpaid_status = #{unpaidStatus} and rcd.rental_contract_no = #{rentalContractNo} group by rcd.monthly_payment_date order by rcd.paid_in_rounds

SELECT c.cust_nm, rcd.paid_in_rounds, rcd.payment_amount, rcd.penalty_fee, rcd.monthly_payment_date, rcd.payment_status, rcd.unpaid_status FROM rental_contract_details rcd inner join payment p on rcd.rental_contract_no = p.rental_contract_no inner join customer c on rcd.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE rcd.rental_contract_no = #{rentalContractNo} group by rcd.monthly_payment_date order by rcd.paid_in_rounds

SELECT COUNT(p.payment_completed_no) FROM payment p INNER JOIN customer c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id INNER JOIN sell_products sp ON p.sell_products_no = sp.sell_products_no INNER JOIN products pd ON sp.products_no = pd.products_no
(p.rental_contract_no != '일시불판매' OR p.rental_contract_no = '일시불판매')
AND sp.ent_ceo_no = #{entCeoNo}
AND c.cust_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND pd.products_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND p.payment_status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')

SELECT c.cust_nm, pd.products_nm, MAX(p.payment_count) AS payment_count, MAX(p.total_price) AS total_price, p.rental_contract_no, MAX(p.payment_status) AS payment_status, MAX(p.payment_completed_date) AS payment_completed_date FROM payment p INNER JOIN customer c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id INNER JOIN sell_products sp ON p.sell_products_no = sp.sell_products_no INNER JOIN products pd ON sp.products_no = pd.products_no
(p.rental_contract_no != '일시불판매' OR p.rental_contract_no = '일시불판매')
AND sp.ent_ceo_no = #{entCeoNo}
AND c.cust_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND pd.products_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
AND p.payment_status LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
GROUP BY p.rental_contract_no ORDER BY MAX(p.payment_completed_date) DESC LIMIT #{pageable.rowPerPage} OFFSET #{pageable.offset}
